01 — The Association Model

One DAO.
Full transparency.
No intermediaries.

The Association is built for investors. The DAO governs every acquisition decision. The technology makes every step transparent and verifiable.

01
Community · Investors

Capital partners with skin in the game.

The association is for investors who share conviction in the three-leg thesis — Bitcoin-native individuals, family offices, and crypto-native capital that wants hard asset exposure without selling the stack. Members are owners of the portfolio, not passive LPs. Governance rights, equity upside, and transparency by default.

The Advisory — an independent licensed entity appointed by the DAO — sources, underwrites, and presents every deal. The DAO votes. The Advisory executes. Every transaction is visible on-chain.
02
Intelligence · Deal Flow

The DAO needs to vote. Members need to know.

Every acquisition goes to a DAO vote. That means members need two bodies of knowledge most investors currently lack: how Portugal's real estate market works at the deal level, and how the BTC/USD/RE macro thesis translates into specific acquisition criteria. The intelligence layer turns passive capital into informed governance.

In practice: The Advisory brings fully underwritten deal packages to the DAO — location, net yield, tokenisation structure, BTC-collateralised financing terms, and exit scenario. Members vote. The best deals get funded.
03
Technology · The Protocol

Transparent by design. Ungovernable by any one party.

Every deal is on-chain. Every vote is recorded. Every ownership stake is verifiable. Every distribution is automatic. The technology replaces opacity with proof — no hidden terms, no manual settlement, no disputed records.

In practice: The Advisory presents a deal. The DAO votes. The TTF tokenises the property SPV. The BTC/USD vault funds the purchase without liquidating the treasury.

The association model draws on existing blockchain-native governance frameworks already operating in Portugal — contribution-based membership, democratic voting, and a culture-first hierarchy that keeps the community at the centre. RealMLS.eth is not starting from scratch.

03 — The Structure

Five layers.
One governance.

The RealMLS.eth DAO governs a five-layer structure. Governance and capital sit on-chain. Operations execute under DAO mandate via independent service providers. Assets — BTC and Portugal RE — are custodied separately. Services (advisory, tokenisation, fund administration) are external and bound by mandate, not ownership.

Highlight layer:
Direct capital / asset flow Obligation · service · periodic return Bidirectional · governance / mandate-report Internal entity External service provider Hover any node for detail · click a layer to highlight
Layer 1 · Governance

Association & DAO

The Association is the cultural and community shell — capital attraction, member relationships. The DAO governs on-chain: every acquisition, disposal, and treasury action requires a 60% supermajority vote with a 7-day window.

Layer 2 · Capital

Capital & Equity

Qualified investors enter at €50,000 minimum. The Ratio Engine allocates equity proportionally to capital committed. DAO shares are issued on-chain via Ethereum — the membership stake. Retail access subject to CMVM regulatory clearance.

Layer 3 · RIT

Operations

The Real Investment Trust is where capital becomes leverage. The BTC Treasury holds 100M sat reserve, never on exchange, multisig from inception. It collateralises the BTC/USD Vault at 30% LTV, borrowing stablecoins at 2–5% APR. Day-to-day operations — NAV, reporting, capital calls — are mandated to a top-tier independent fund administrator selected from leading global firms. The Mgmt Co reports to the DAO. The DAO governs. The BTC is never sold.

Layer 4 · Assets

BTC & Property

BTC held in multisig custody, never moved to exchanges. Portugal real estate held in individual property SPVs — one SPV per asset for clean liability ringfencing and disposal optionality.

Layer 5 · Services

Advisory & TTF

The Advisory is a top-tier institutional commercial real estate firm — CBRE, Cushman & Wakefield, JLL, Savills, Knight Frank class — appointed by the DAO to source, underwrite, and execute every acquisition. TTF tokenises each SPV and issues equity to members. Both are external, bound by mandate, not ownership.

How a deal flows through the structure

  1. Capital in. LP commits €50K+ via the Association. Ratio Engine issues on-chain DAO equity.
  2. Treasury allocates. ~60% of capital deployed to BTC, held in multisig. BTC never leaves custody.
  3. Vault borrows. BTC posted as collateral at 30% LTV. Stablecoins drawn at 2–5% APR.
  4. Advisory sources. Top-tier institutional advisor (CBRE / Cushman & Wakefield / JLL / Savills / Knight Frank class) surfaces a deal, runs full institutional underwriting, prepares the dossier.
  5. DAO votes. 60% supermajority required. 7-day window. Vote is on-chain and public to members.
  6. Acquisition executes. Mgmt Co — under DAO mandate — releases stablecoins from the vault and coordinates closing into a dedicated SPV.
  7. TTF tokenises. The SPV is wrapped on-chain; members hold proportional equity in the asset.
  8. Yield flows. Net rental income converts to EURC and distributes quarterly to DAO members.

Structural alpha is in not selling the BTC. The spread between BTC appreciation (40–60% per 4-year cycle) and borrow cost (2–5% APR) is the trade. Portugal RE pays the carry. The DAO makes it transparent enough for institutional LPs to trust.

10 — Legal Precedent

Not just a DAO.
A legal milestone.

RealMLS.eth has a genuine legal ambition: to be the first blockchain real estate association formally recognised under Portuguese and EU law — setting the precedent for how on-chain property institutions are structured across Europe.

Portugal · CMVM pathway

The CMVM (Comissão do Mercado de Valores Mobiliários) is a navigable regulator. The TTF and equity token structure need formal opinion, but Portugal has shown willingness to engage with blockchain entities. VdA and Morais Leitão have the relevant expertise.

Luxembourg · MiCA compliance

The holdco sits in Luxembourg — Eytan's home jurisdiction, MiCA-compliant, with the treaty network for Portugal RE investment. Luxembourg RAIF or Portuguese FIA are both viable structures for the RIT. Luxembourg gives institutional credibility to family office investors.

Associative law · Portugal

Blockchain-native associations have already navigated Portuguese associative law — written constitutions, ENS identities, contribution-based membership. The path is established. RealMLS.eth can follow it with confidence.

ENS identity · on-chain permanence

RealMLS.eth is hosted on ENS/IPFS — a fully on-chain identity. The ENS record is the on-chain identity of the institution — renewed annually, uncensorable, and ungovernable by any single party.

05b — A Deal, End to End

How one acquisition
actually works.

The Advisory identifies a property. The DAO votes. The vault funds it. The SPV is tokenised. Rental yield flows to members. Here is what that looks like in practice.

Step 01
Advisory sources deal
Lisbon apartment, €750K asking. Net yield 4.2% after management. IMT and closing costs budgeted at €65K. Full underwriting package prepared.
Step 02
DAO votes
Members vote on-chain within 7 days. Requires 60% supermajority to proceed. Independent valuation confirms €750K is fair market. Vote passes.
Step 03
Vault funds it
15 BTC posted as collateral (30% LTV). ~€400K in stablecoins borrowed at 3.5% APR. Combined with €415K from the treasury, total acquisition funded.
Step 04
SPV tokenised
Property held in a Portuguese LDA (SPV). TTF issues 750,000 tokens at €1 each — distributed to DAO members pro-rata. Each token represents fractional ownership of the SPV.
Step 05
Yield distributed
€31,500/yr net rental yield (4.2% × €750K). Distributed quarterly via smart contract in EURC. Members receive proportional to their token holdings. On-chain, automatic, auditable.

07b — Tax Structure

Lux holdco.
Portuguese SPVs.

A first-pass tax structure for the institution — designed to compound efficiently across BTC, Portugal RE, and multi-jurisdictional LPs, then validated by formal opinion from VdA / Morais Leitão (PT) and Arendt / Loyens (LU) before the first close.

Layer Vehicle Treatment (first pass)
Holdco Luxembourg RAIF or SOPARFI RAIF preferred for institutional credibility. Tax-transparent at the fund level. Subject to a flat 0.01% subscription tax. EU passporting available. SOPARFI as a fallback uses the EU Parent-Subsidiary Directive.
Asset SPVs Portuguese LDA per asset 21% IRC on net rental income. IMT 6–8% on each acquisition. Stamp duty 0.8%. IMI annual property tax ~0.3–0.45% of VPT. Each SPV is separately ringfenced for liability.
SPV → Holdco EU Parent-Subsidiary Dividends from PT SPV up to LU holdco are generally exempt from PT withholding tax under the EU Parent-Subsidiary Directive (LU holds 10%+ of SPV equity for 12+ months).
BTC Treasury LU holdco direct or DAO multisig LU treats BTC held >6 months as private wealth — gains generally exempt at corporate level for SOPARFI under participation regime questions; RAIF holding crypto requires AIFM-licensed manager. Treaty network: LU has DTAs with PT, IL, FR, and most UAE-relevant jurisdictions.
Tokenisation TTF — administrative If structured as administrative re-titling within an existing SPV (no change of ownership), tokenisation is not a taxable event. CMVM and PT tax authority opinion required to confirm. Alternative: secondary token issuance event treated as capital contribution.
LP distributions EURC quarterly Distributions classed as fund returns. LU RAIF is generally not subject to LU withholding tax on distributions to non-resident LPs. Each LP's home jurisdiction taxes per local rules — IL, UAE, US, and EU treaty networks all applicable.
Carry / fees LU performance fee 20% above 8% hurdle structured as performance allocation at LU level. 1.5% AUM management fee deducted at the fund level. Advisory deal fees expensed at the SPV level on each acquisition.
First-pass design only. Requires formal tax opinion from VdA or Morais Leitão (Portugal) and Arendt & Medernach or Loyens & Loeff (Luxembourg) before first close. CMVM ruling required on tokenisation tax treatment.
07c — Risk & Stress Testing

What could break this.
To be modeled before first close.

Every leg of this structure carries real risk. The pitch assumes BTC compounds, Portugal RE appreciates, DeFi protocols hold, regulators stay friendly. Each of these can fail — independently or together. A full quantitative stress-test framework is to be built and disclosed to LPs before the first capital is wired. The categories below are the scope.

Market risk

BTC + RE drawdown scenarios

BTC -50%, -70%, -85% scenarios modeled against vault LTV. Combined: BTC -70% + Portugal RE flat for 3 years + EUR/USD -15%. Cascade analysis: at what point does the vault liquidate? What does forced BTC sale do to the treasury thesis? Recovery paths.

Operational risk

Smart contract & oracle failure

Smart contract exploit on the lending protocol or TTF. Oracle manipulation leading to wrongful liquidation. Multisig key compromise. Custody breach. Each scenario needs a defined response, insurance coverage, and a recovery protocol disclosed to LPs.

Regulatory risk

CMVM, MiCA, banking

CMVM rules change mid-fundraise. MiCA reclassification of the equity token. EU bank de-risking blocks EUR rails. Portugal removes Golden Visa equivalents. Plan: ENS-on-IPFS continuity, fallback jurisdictions, wind-down mechanism enabling LPs to exit cleanly.

Liquidity & counterparty

DeFi concentration, redemption

Single-protocol concentration (Aave, Ledn) — diversify across 2–3 lenders or move to regulated CeFi (Sygnum, Anchorage). Redemption pressure during a drawdown vs. 12-month lock and 10% quarterly cap. SPV liquidity for property-level exits.

Status

Quantitative stress-test models are to be built and disclosed as part of the LP data room. Each category above receives a Monte Carlo simulation and a deterministic worst-case scenario. The output is a one-page risk addendum delivered to every LP before commitment. This is not optional — it is a precondition for institutional capital.

11 — Open Questions

What we need
to resolve together.

Structural decisions that need to be resolved before legal formation begins. None are blockers at concept stage — but each has real implications for the capital raise and governance design.

01

Equity form — token or trust unit?

ERC-1400 security token / ERC-20 governance token / RIT trust units. The legal form determines CMVM requirements and the governance model. Needs legal opinion before proceeding.

02

RIT jurisdiction?

Portuguese FIA or Luxembourg RAIF. Luxembourg preferred given MiCA compliance and existing ties. Determines tax treatment and investor access rules for the capital raise.

03

What is TTF exactly?

Internal mechanism or licensed entity? CMVM review required to determine whether it constitutes a regulated securities issuance platform before the first tokenised deal.

04

BTC treasury domicile?

Luxembourg holdco (MiCA-friendly) or separate DAO multisig treasury with independent governance. Determines custody risk profile and institutional LP comfort level.

05

Advisory selection & engagement

Which top-tier firm becomes the Advisory? CBRE, Cushman & Wakefield, JLL, Savills, and Knight Frank are all viable. Selection criteria: Portuguese RE specialism, family-office credibility, willingness to work under a DAO-mandate framework, fee structure on the 1% deal model. Mandate scope and conflict policy to be agreed in writing before first close.

06

Static or dynamic ratio engine?

Fixed equity allocation at time of entry vs. dynamic oracle-fed ratio adjusting with BTC/USD market conditions. Impacts fairness for later investors and governance complexity.

07

The 0% APR mechanism — what is the actual rate?

The original whiteboard sketch suggested a near-0% APR via a smart-contract swap or atomic-swap mechanic — Jonathan's design. The current pitch assumes 2–5% APR via Aave / Ledn / equivalent for institutional credibility. Open question for Eytan: what was Jonathan describing in the meeting? If a 0% (or near-0%) borrowing structure is real and durable, the structural alpha is materially larger and the pitch should be rebuilt around it. Needs walkthrough with Jonathan before the next iteration.

08

Is “RealMLS” the right name?

MLS (Multiple Listing Service) is a US/Canadian realtor-industry concept. Family-office LPs in Luxembourg, Israel, the UAE, and Portugal will not recognise the reference. The .eth domain is excellent — uncensorable, on-chain identity. The “RealMLS” prefix may not travel. Worth pressure-testing with the family-office cohort before the raise opens. Alternatives to consider: RealVault.eth, PortugalDAO.eth, BTCRE.eth, Sovereign.eth, or a Portuguese-rooted name.

1. Investment Thesis

A ten-year macro trade built on three reinforcing legs. Each leg hedges and amplifies the others.

LegThesis
Long BitcoinBTC is the hardest asset ever created. The monetisation trade — absorbing gold's market cap and achieving sovereign reserve status — is credible over ten years. Basis risk is regulatory, not structural.
Short USD$36T in US debt, $1T/quarter in interest payments. Fiscal dominance forces the Fed's hand. The dollar does not collapse — it dilutes. EUR-denominated assets provide structural protection. The vault borrows fiat at 2–5% APR against BTC; BTC historically outpaces that cost by 10× over any sustained 4-year cycle.
Long Portugal RELisbon at €5–6K/m² vs. Paris at €10–12K. Tourism infrastructure mature. Supply constrained by licensing bureaucracy. Golden Visa restructuring shifted demand inward. EUR hedge against USD debasement is structural.
2. The DAO: RealMLS.eth

The venture is governed by a Decentralised Autonomous Organisation registered as RealMLS.eth on Ethereum. The Association sits above the DAO as the investor community layer. Below it, the Real Investment Trust holds and manages the assets.

The Association is for investors — Bitcoin-native individuals, family offices, and crypto-native capital seeking hard asset exposure without liquidating their BTC position. Members hold governance rights and equity upside. Minimum entry: €50,000 (qualified investors). Retail access subject to CMVM regulatory clearance.

EntityRole
RealMLS AssociationThe investor community. Governs the DAO. Members vote on all major decisions.
RealMLS.eth DAOOn-chain governance. Votes on every acquisition, treasury allocation, and major structural decision.
Real Investment Trust (RIT)The legal wrapper holding all assets. Likely structured as a Portuguese FIA or Luxembourg RAIF.
Management CompanyDay-to-day operations within the RIT: investor reporting, coordination, treasury management.
The AdvisoryTop-tier institutional CRE firm — CBRE, Cushman & Wakefield, JLL, Savills, or Knight Frank class. Appointed by the DAO. Sole source of deal flow — sourcing, underwriting, and executing all property acquisitions.
TTFToken Transfer Facility — the mechanism for tokenising property SPVs and issuing equity tokens to DAO members.
3. Three-Tier Architecture

The operational structure flows across three defined layers, governed top-down by the DAO:

LayerComponents
Layer 1 — Capital & EquityFamily offices and qualified investors enter at €50K minimum. Ratio engine allocates equity proportionally. On-chain DAO shares issued via Ethereum.
Layer 2 — Operations (RIT)BTC treasury posts collateral. Vault borrows stablecoins at 2–5% APR against BTC. Management Co deploys capital into acquisitions on DAO approval.
Layer 3 — AssetsBTC in multisig custody. Portugal RE in individual property SPVs. TTF tokenises each SPV. The Advisory sources, underwrites, and executes every acquisition.

See Appendix 1 for the original hand-drawn sketch from the April 7th meeting.

4. The BTC/USD Vault — How It Actually Works

This is the alpha engine of the structure. The BTC treasury is not sold to buy property. It is posted as collateral in a DeFi lending protocol to borrow stablecoins, which are then used to acquire Portuguese real estate. The BTC position compounds untouched.

  • BTC posted as collateral at 30% LTV (liquidation risk managed at this ratio)
  • Stablecoins borrowed at 2–5% APR (market DeFi rates — Aave, Ledn, or equivalent)
  • BTC has historically appreciated at 40–60% annually over sustained 4-year cycles
  • The spread between borrow cost and BTC appreciation is the structural alpha
  • RE acquired with borrowed fiat; rental yield services the borrow cost with significant surplus
  • In a 50% BTC drawdown: LTV rises to 60% — still above liquidation threshold if LTV kept below 30%

Carry cost is real and is included in all return projections. "0% borrowing" is not the claim — the claim is that the spread is structural and persistent over a decade.

Capital → BTC TreasuryCapital allocated to BTC reserve. Held in multisig custody. Never on exchange.
BTC → VaultBTC posted as collateral. Stablecoins borrowed at 2–5% APR at 30% LTV.
USD → AdvisoryBorrowed stablecoins deployed to acquire Portugal RE on DAO vote. Property held in individual SPV.
SPV → TTFProperty tokenised. Fractional equity tokens issued to DAO members proportionally.

Exit12-month lock-up. Quarterly redemption windows (up to 10% of pool). SPV tokens tradeable on secondary market from year 2. Full dissolution vote from year 8.
6. A Deal, End to End
#ActionDetail
01Advisory sources dealLisbon apartment, €750K asking. Net yield 4.2% after management. IMT and closing costs budgeted at €65K. Full underwriting package prepared.
02DAO votesMembers vote on-chain within 7 days. Requires 60% supermajority. Independent valuation confirms €750K is fair. Vote passes.
03Vault funds it15 BTC posted at 30% LTV. ~€400K borrowed at 3.5% APR. Combined with €415K from treasury, total €815K covers acquisition + costs.
04SPV tokenisedProperty held in Portuguese LDA (SPV). TTF issues 750,000 tokens at €1 each, distributed to members pro-rata.
05Yield distributed€31,500/yr net rental yield (4.2% × €750K). Distributed quarterly in EURC via smart contract. Automatic. On-chain. Auditable.

◆ These five functions must always remain independent of the Management Co.

11. The Growth Loop

Each new investor strengthens the portfolio for the next. More capital enables better deals; better deals generate better returns; better returns attract more capital.

12. Legal Structure
JurisdictionStructure
Luxembourg (holdco)MiCA-compliant. Preferred domicile for the holding company. RAIF structure for the RIT gives institutional LP credibility and broad investment mandate.
Portugal (operations)CMVM is a navigable regulator. TTF and equity token require formal legal opinion before first issuance. VdA and Morais Leitão recommended.
ENS identityRealMLS.eth registered on Ethereum Name Service. Renewed annually. On-chain identity for the DAO — uncensorable, ungovernable by any single party.
Property SPVsEach acquisition held in a separate Portuguese LDA (Sociedade Unipessoal). Limits liability per asset. TTF tokenises the SPV equity.
13. Open Questions
#QuestionOptions / Notes
1Equity form — token or trust unit?ERC-1400 security token / ERC-20 governance token / RIT trust units. Determines CMVM filing requirements.
2RIT jurisdiction?Portuguese FIA or Luxembourg RAIF. Luxembourg preferred given MiCA compliance and existing ties.
3What is TTF legally?Internal mechanism or licensed entity? CMVM review required before first token issuance.
4BTC treasury domicile?Luxembourg holdco or separate DAO multisig. Determines custody risk profile and LP requirements.
5Advisory structure — legal scope?Can advisory and brokerage execution sit within the same licensed entity, or require separate legal wrappers?
6Dynamic or static ratio engine?Fixed equity at entry vs. oracle-fed ratio adjusting with BTC/USD. Impacts fairness for later investors.
14. Next Steps
  • Legal opinion: Engage VdA or Morais Leitão (Lisbon) for CMVM advisory on TTF and equity token classification. Initiate Luxembourg holdco formation.
  • Entity structure: Determine Luxembourg RAIF vs. Portuguese FIA for the RIT. Agree Advisory entity structure.
  • BTC custody: Establish regulated multisig custody. Test DeFi borrowing facility at small scale before committing treasury.
  • First tokenised deal: Advisory brings first deal to DAO for vote. Tokenise SPV. Issue equity tokens to founding members. Test full stack end-to-end.
  • Placement agent: Identify licensed placement agent for LP outreach in Luxembourg, Israel, and UAE.
  • Follow-up meeting: Align on legal structure, Advisory entity design, and target LP list.
